name: Druid’s Vestment (Magic Skull Games)
body:
DESCRIPTION

Shapeshifters may wear druid’s vestments. This grants one more daily use of their Shapechange ability, but not their Form of the Mythical Beast, Form of the Dragon, or Giant Form abilities.

Grimoire Viperian: A Tome of Exotic Lore Copyright 2021 Magic Skull Games Author: Steven F. Johnson
